title: Conformance on the sandbox (TARGET=sandbox), including unauthorized cases
description:
Run `features/data` with the TypeScript runner against the sandbox as a member and as a curator, plus the `@auth` unauthorized scenarios and the `@sandbox` scenarios from apricitus-dc4989.

## Verify
`TARGET=sandbox npm run conformance` all green.

---
**Repo:** `~/Projects/Ripple`, branch `master` (don't switch).
**Toolchain:** `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH`; Python `analysis/.venv/bin/python`; web `cd web && npm …`.
**Protocol:** initiative `apricitus-e70662`: specs first; log with `kbs comment`; run **Verify** and paste the output tail; label `ready-for-review`; never commit, push, close, or deploy. Don't change visuals in `web/src/ui/*` (the web session owns them); data calls only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Carried from apricitus-bb2b6c: implement sandbox sign-in in web/test/conformance/world.ts. Per user switch: signOut, signIn({username, password}) from SANDBOX_USERS, read the sub from fetchAuthSession (tokens.idToken.payload.sub), cache it for ${sub:user}, create the client with authMode userPool. The test accounts need their groups assigned (members/curators/admins) in the sandbox's user pool.
